purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: writing lecture; vocabulary (示す/単純/意図/比較的/限界) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い文章は、意図を明確に示します。
lines.en: Good writing clearly shows its intent.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 単純な文の方が、いいんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単純さは、比較的伝わりやすいです。
lines.en: Simplicity is relatively easy to convey.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 単純すぎると、限界がありますか?
lines.en: Is there a limit if it's too simple?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、単純さにも限界があります。
lines.en: Yes, simplicity has its limits too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 意図は、どう示せばいいですか?
lines.en: How should I show the intent?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 比較的早く、結論で意図を示します。
lines.en: Show the intent relatively early, in the conclusion.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 限界を知って、工夫するんですね。
lines.en: We know the limits and get creative.
lines.style: moved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
